name: c3-rtq-retest-with-204regs
evidence: TIDAL_RTQ=1 at spec=64 (204-reg budget, GPU3): 2.6813ms vs 0.8694 control at 1M/k8192 -- still 3x regression, recall fine (0.9987). The old register-ceiling hypothesis is DISPROVEN as the sole cause: the row-tagged smem queue structure itself (queue traffic + flush machinery in the QN64 hot loop) loses to parallel-reservation direct emit. Definitively closed.

name: c5-scaled-q-bucket-in-mma
evidence: USER-PROPOSED: fold the bucket transform's linear part into the MMA -- host pre-scales each query row by -inv_delta_r (tidal_scale_q_kernel, ~3us), so the TMEM accumulator IS the bucket coordinate y=inv*x; the gate collapses from ~10 ops/element (neg+FMA+cast+clamp+2 cmps + unconditional fp16-rounded histogram bucket) to ONE float compare y < bound_r where bound=(gate+1)+inv*o lives in smem and updates at gate-reread. Passing elements (~1%) recover x=y*delta and recompute the histogram bucket FROM THE STORED VALUE (fp16-rounded for half) -- preserves the fp16 bucket invariant by construction. Dense-ablation path keeps raw Q. Results: 12/16 cells improve up to -3.7% (5M/k4096 1.876->1.806, 4M row -2.0~-2.8%), 1M row +0.4~+1.8% (pipeline-fill dominated + scale launch), tidal k128 -2.7%; recall unchanged everywhere (0.996-0.999). New peaks: 4M/k128 3.00x, 5M/k128 3.21x, 5M/k8192 2.01x.

name: c5b-inplace-bucket-branchy
evidence: USER-CLARIFIED design v1: compute bucket id in place once, integer gate braw<=gate, reuse bucket+score on hit -- but with the work moved INSIDE if(g). Measured WORSE than even the C2 baseline (5M/k4096 2.127 vs 1.875; 1M/k128 0.538 vs 0.503): the predicated body breaks the compiler's interleaving of the 8 unrolled FMA->CVT->CMP chains -- ILP loss dwarfs the instruction savings. Fewer instructions != faster when the loop lives on ILP.

name: c5c-inplace-bucket-branchless
evidence: Same user design, branchless: bucket id computed unconditionally ONCE (fp32 path reuses it for gate AND histogram -- identical expression to the select's recompute, invariant holds; fp16 keeps the rounded-value bucket), straight-line code preserves 8-way ILP. Beats ALL prior variants on every probed cell: 1M/k128 0.485-0.491 (best ever), 5M/k4096 1.791-1.798, 5M/k8192 2.141. Replaces C5 scaled-Q (reverted: no scale kernel, exact scores, simpler). Full matrix: 16/16 >= 1.13x, recall >= 0.9958; tidal k128 0.559 / k4096 0.819 also best-ever. Env TIDAL_EPILOGUE_C5B=0 keeps the pre-C5 baseline for A/B.

name: carveout-pitfall-and-fix
evidence: Cleanup deleted the RTQ 16.6KB smem reservation -> QN64 launch request 210->193KB -> L1/smem carveout bucket 228->196KB (+32KB L1) -> k=128 column ~5% SLOWER (1M/k128 0.49->0.52ms, reproducible; dummy pad restored speed -- causal). Mechanism: th_bucket/gate re-reads are plain loads; a larger NON-COHERENT L1 serves staler (looser) thresholds -> over-emission; small k most threshold-sensitive. Fix: cudaFuncAttributePreferredSharedMemoryCarveout=MaxShared at dispatch. Final reproducible matrix: 1M 1.72/1.50/1.14/1.13x; 2M 2.37/2.03/1.53/1.38x; 4M 3.00/2.69/2.14/1.84x; 5M 3.20/2.90/2.38/2.03x.

name: c6-bucket-space-candidate-storage
evidence: USER-PROPOSED (2026-07-12): don't store the raw score after computing the bucket id -- store the bucket-space coordinate bq=(x-o)*inv directly (a float, order-preserving affine transform, NOT the truncated int bucket id); select never reconstructs x (radix/boundary comparisons are order-invariant under bq), only the FINAL K outputs per row get converted back to real scores via one host-side ATen affine (val=bq*delta+o, fused into the existing negate step) instead of a per-candidate recompute. Removes the origin/inv_delta subtract-multiply from flashtopk_compact_thr_kernel's hot per-candidate loop entirely (just a cast). Verified with an EXPLICIT VALUE check (bench's recall() only compares index sets, would NOT catch a wrong-value bug) -- profile/verify_bucket_space_values.py: max_abs_err 4.5e-4 (fp32, pure rounding) vs dense ground truth. CRITICAL COMPATIBILITY BUG found and fixed: tidal's default sample_mode=0 (tail-window) uses the legacy arch-agnostic launch_hopper_seed_from_sample_fp16 to prefill buf_val with RAW SCORES -- that kernel is unaware of bucket-space storage, so mixing it with a scan that unconditionally stored bq broke tidal recall to 0.22-0.69. Fixed by adding a runtime store_bucket_space flag (= strided_sample) threaded through the scan kernel (runtime bool, ~2-4% cost -- not templated, a documented follow-up) and flashtopk_compact_thr_kernel (BUCKET_SPACE template bool, zero cost) and the host debucket step (skipped for !strided_sample, old value convention preserved). marsco (always strided_sample=1) unaffected in correctness; measured ~2-4% slower across the matrix (0.497->0.513ms @1M/k128) from the added runtime branch + kernel param -- within the previously-documented build-to-build variance band, follow-up: template-ize store_bucket_space to recover it. tidal (sample_mode=0 default) recall restored to 0.999+.
